session.title: Threshold in control.
session.subtitle: Build a sustainable rhythm around threshold. Fast work, deliberate recoveries, steady form.

segments.title: Easy run
segments.instruction: Conversational pace; finish feeling ready to move faster.

segments.title: 4 × 20 second strides
segments.instruction: Run four controlled 20 second accelerations with easy jogging between. This five minute block includes the jog recovery.

segments.title: Threshold effort
segments.instruction: Controlled effort; keep form smooth. Do not chase HR in the first minute.

target.label: Between current 10K and 5K pace
target.note: Adjust for heat, hills and response.

segments.title: Easy jog
segments.instruction: Slow down, then walk as needed.

focus.title: Two minute focus
items: Read the session and select a safe route.
Check fatigue, soreness, symptoms and conditions.
Pick one cue: smooth shoulders and relaxed steps.
Mute notifications if safe; keep navigation and emergency access available.
focus.note: A routine can support attention, but silence or visualization does not guarantee better performance.

preFuel.title: Fuel this 60 minute session
items: A familiar meal roughly 2–3 hours before may cover this session.
If you have not eaten for several hours, consider a familiar easy to digest carbohydrate snack.
Bring water according to conditions, route access, thirst and your own sweat history. Carbohydrate during this hour is optional.
preFuel.note: No sodium or caffeine dose is inferred from pace alone.

postFuel.title: Recovery meal
items: Eat a normal meal containing carbohydrate and protein within the next few hours. The illustrative 75 kg profile suggests about 23 g protein using 0.3 g/kg.

If another demanding session is less than roughly 8 hours away, plan faster carbohydrate restoration with professional or coach context. An illustrative rapid target is 75–90 g carbohydrate per hour (1.0–1.2 g/kg/h) for the first few hours.
postFuel.note: With more time before the next hard session, daily intake matters more than exact immediate timing.

downshift.title: Optional breathing practice
items: If comfortable, try gentle breathing for two minutes; stop if dizzy.
downshift.note: This may feel calming; no autonomic reset or faster recovery is promised.

checkIn.title: How did it go?
items: Record duration, session effort, symptoms and how the workout felt.
Use your response to inform the next plan.
